entities.summary: The Sandro Girgvliani murder case is one of the most notorious criminal cases in the modern history of Georgia. The killing in January 2006, and the events that followed, generated heavy criticism of the former government, particularly the interior minister, and debate about the extent to which then President Mikheil Saakashvili had truly introduced judicial independence and a democratic culture into Georgian society.
